Package com.javiergs.rtde4j.model

Class RobotState

java.lang.Object
com.javiergs.rtde4j.model.RobotState
public class RobotState extends Object
Mutable aggregate of calibration, joint, Cartesian, kinematics, and mode data. Getters return references to the contained mutable objects; this is not a synchronized snapshot.
Version:
1.0.0 (2026.10.26)
